The '''''Ripclaw''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. It was apparently named after an [[Ripclaw|Alderaanian predator]].

==History==
It was dispatched to the [[Delphon system/Legends|Delphon system]] in order to repel the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Gang]] which were heavily raiding [[Delphon/Legends|Delphon]], causing its economy to collapse. The arrival of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] caused the gang to scatter.
